name: undo-button

frames.best_why: Shows the pending pill reading "Archived | Undo 5 ⌘Z" with its outline freshly draining; other frames show idle buttons.

tagline: Turns a plain action into a countdown you can still take back.
summary: A pill action button that opens a short undo window when pressed. It widens into a past-tense label with an Undo action, a ticking number and a command-key hint while its outline slowly drains, then commits.
appearance: A small rounded pill with a thin outline, a leading line icon and a label, sitting in a row beside a second matching pill. In the pending state it stretches to fit a grey past-tense word, a divider, an Undo arrow, a large countdown digit and a small key hint.
behaviour: Pressing swaps the label to past tense and starts a countdown as the border empties clockwise from the top. Hovering pauses the clock, pressing again or the shortcut cancels, and when time runs out a tick replaces the label.
demo_content: A message from Priya Raman about moving a Q3 roadmap review, with Archive and Delete buttons beneath.
search_phrases: archive button that can be undone
cmd z to undo an action
button that turns into undo prompt
use_when: A destructive or hard-to-reverse action needs a short take-back window without opening a full dialog.
avoid_when: Undo lasts only a few seconds and the wide pending pill needs row space; not a substitute for real confirmation.
customise: Props set the verb and past-tense label, the leading icon, the undo window, how long the done state lingers and three callbacks; colours and outline styling need a source edit.
weight_why: One small button with a resize observer and a countdown frame loop that runs only while pending.

a11y.note: Button, shortcut, focus ring and phase labels are all present, but the global Cmd/Ctrl+Z listener can clash with a page's own undo.

issues: The pending pill is wide and can push the neighbouring button off a narrow row.
polish_why: Clean state change and a clever draining outline; the idle pill itself is ordinary.
